NVDA $HSII $ARM - NVIDIA HIRES HEIDRICK & STRUGGLES TO FIND NEW CEO Nvidia has hired executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles to lead its CEO search following Jensen Huang's resignation, according to The Wall Street Journal. The search, led by Jeff Sanders, will consider internal and external candidates, with Arm CEO Rene Haas reportedly among those approached. Colette Kress remains interim CEO. Despite Huang's willingness to return, Nvidia's board is reportedly not considering reinstatement.
